A family business since 1953 In 1953, Wilhelm Sülzle split his long-established ironmongery factory among his sons and his son-in-law Heinrich Blickle into three standalone companies. The newly founded company Blickle assumed the production of iron wheelbarrow wheels, developing it into a range of high-quality wheels in addition to swivel and fixed castors. Typically Swabian virtues such as hard work, an obsession with quality and the genes of inventors all contribute to continual product improvement. After the sudden death of the company’s founder Heinrich Blickle in 1961, his wife Elisabeth Blickle took over as Managing Director.
Today, Reinhold Blickle, son of the company’s founder, runs the company as executive partner together with his wife Denise Blickle and Walter Wager. Under their management, Blickle has developed into one of the leading manufacturers of wheels and castors worldwide over the past few decades. Progress and keeping with the traditional values of the family company go hand in hand – a corporate philosophy that will be continued into the third generation.

businesses.address: 50 Skinner Shoot Road Byron Bay Nsw Australia 2481
businesses.description:
Local businessmen Nathan Folkes and Jason Saville are launching their very own organic farm in the heart of Byron Bay. Starting in June 2015 and officially opening our doors in September 2015, Byron Bay Harvest aims to bring healthy, organic food right to your door. Compared to some of the fruit and vegetable produce available at Australia’s major wholesale outlets, Byron Bay Harvest strives to provide financially affordable organic food with the added ease of it being delivered to you direct.

Farmed locally in Byron Bay, the quality-assured crops cultivated by BBH will also be available to buy at local markets, from our local schools and directly from our website…

The company was founded and completely focused upon being able to provide fresh organic produce to the local people at affordable prices. Jason Saville, the driving force behind this goal, has been involved in farming since the early age of five years old and has always been an active part of his family farm. In his early twenties he then went on to work as a jackaroo in Oberon. Where his passion for fresh produce developed further. Jason then went on to set up an organic farm for a client down in the Blue Mountains, which gave him the push to set up his own organic farm in his hometown of Byron Bay.

Jason says “I've always found the prices of organic produce in supermarkets shockingly high and have finally decided to do something about it in my community. It's all about enlivening our community by relieving our reliance on supermarkets and knowing exactly where our fruit and vegetables come from. I have devolved a passion for organic farming and teaching communities about the benefits and practices around organics. We look forward to bringing some great benefits to the community and beyond through this exciting project”

businesses.name: Dan The Sparky Man
businesses.address: Unit 2/65 Township Dr, Burleigh Heads QLD 4220, Australia
businesses.description:
About Us

With our professional team of Gold Coast electricians nothing’s a problem!

For people living on or near the Gold Coast, your home is your sanctuary. And with more of us working and spending time at home, who doesn’t want to spend a little time and money to make your life as comfortable as possible?

Our Gold Coast-based team of skilled tradespeople focus on new home construction, renovations and commercial projects.

About Us

Starting out as just one man in a van, Dan Carpenter has built his business to be one of the most successful and reliable electrical businesses on the Gold Coast.

Here’s the ‘Dan story’ in a nutshell.

Dan completed his apprenticeship in Adelaide and became a professional electrician by the age of 20.

In the great Aussie tradition, he took a ‘gap’ year, cruising the Whitsundays and doing work for a Charterboat Company.

Dan quickly made the decision that he liked being his own boss. So, he started his own show at the age of 22.

In 2006, Dan transferred to the Gold Coast and set up shop. Starting from scratch with zero clients or contacts, he pounded the pavement doing letterbox drops and checking out real estate agents, lighting stores and local businesses to drum up some work.

Between 2007 and 2011 Dan slowly grew his team to meet the need for the local building and booming solar industry.

Won the local Gold Coast Small Business Award for Trades and Services and was a finalist for the GC Young Entrepreneur of the Year in 2012.

In 2013, Dan had the honour of working in Vietnam after a client asked him to project manage a major electrical refurbishment of his factory. He led a team of 20 local electricians to bring the factory’s wiring up to Australian Standards. (And when you don’t speak Vietnamese, this was quite the job!)

After an intensive review process, Dan qualified as an Accredited Master Electrician in 2013.

In the past 7 years, Dan and his wife Kelly have worked tirelessly to grow the business – training, upskilling and developing the team – and building a reputation as the best in the business! (While at the same time, raising a growing family of three)

Dan was given some wise advice by the owner of one of the Lighting Stores when he first moved to the Gold Coast. He said…

“Mate, all you’ve got to do to survive here on the Gold Coast is to show up when you say you are going to and do a good job – that’s it – because no-one else is doing it”

Dan took that advice. It’s what he focused on back then, and it’s how his whole team still works today.

Show Up & Do an amazing job & Clean-up

Thanks to these basic principles (plus Dan’s near superhuman work ethic), the business has expanded from that single van to a team of 12.

businesses.description:
Ensitech is an Australian-owned manufacturing company based in Sydney. It is the award-winning developer of the TIG Brush® Stainless Steel Weld Cleaning System and the Ensitech Surface Finishing System.
Ensitech produces high-quality products which change the way users do business by providing a safe, efficient alternative to dangerous and contaminating industrial practices. It does this by combining technical analysis and innovation with marketing and financial expertise to bring leading-edge products and concepts to the marketplace in a commercially viable system.
Ensitech’s first product, the TIG Brush®, uses the company’s patented power management technology, together with a conductive brush and chemical solutions of proprietary design, to clean and passivate stainless steel welds without the need for dangerous chemicals such as pickling paste.
Ensitech manufactures and exports TIG Brush products to more than 25 countries and has a worldwide network of distributors. Ensitech Inc. is a subsidiary company located in Chicago, Illinois, to service the North American market.
The company has been a member of the Australian Technology Showcase (ATS) and a winner and finalist in numerous business awards. In 2012 it won the 50th Australian Export Awards (Small Business Category), the NSW Premier’s Export Award (Small Business) and two NSW Business Chamber awards (Excellence in Innovation and Business of the Year).

businesses.description:
At E-x Solutions we offer consultancy services in the application of standards to the field of explosion protection.

Whether your work site requires a hazardous area inspection, hazardous area audit, or you're a manufacturer in need of pre-certification assessment for your latest product, we’re here to help. Our electrical and compliance engineers are dedicated to the pursuit of excellence when it comes to explosion protection and committed to providing expert solutions.

At all times we encourage our clients to work with us in an open and transparent environment to ensure the best outcome, which keeps risk as low as reasonably practicable.

Across the world, most places require electrical equipment that is used in explosive atmospheres to undergo a rigorous certification process in order to confirm that it complies with the relevant equipment standards.

Depending on where you are different standards will apply, however, wherever you are the idea is the same: all standards include requirements relating to equipment construction and performance.

By maintaining an up to date and detailed knowledge of both Australian and International hazard area standards, we can ensure that the highest level of safety is maintained in hazardous areas.

Our aim at all times is to work with our clients to provide the best possible solution, while always referring to the appropriate hazardous area standards. When you commission E-x Solutions as your hazardous area consultant you can rest assured that all of the necessary decisions will be fully documented with accuracy and precision, and that we will endeavour to clearly explain everything in plain language.

So if you use equipment in explosive atmospheres but are unsure about exactly how the hazard area standards apply to you, don’t hesitate to call one of our experts to organise a consultation.

At ExBo Visual, our passion is turning your creative visions into vibrant realities. With a history spanning over 120 years in the realm of print and signage solutions, we've not only honed our craft but also embraced sustainability and inclusivity as core values.

When you partner with ExBo Visual, you're not just another client; you're a collaborator in a creative journey. We take the time to understand your unique goals and aspirations. Whether you represent a government entity, an industry leader, or a dynamic business, we respect the significance of your brand. We are here to translate your ideas into tangible, visually captivating solutions that leave a lasting impression.

ExBo Visual's legacy is a tapestry woven with the threads of excellence. For well over a century, we've been the go-to choice for discerning clients across a diverse range of sectors, including construction, property development, mining, oil and gas, hospitality, retail, healthcare, QSR (Quick Service Restaurants), events, branding, advertising, architecture, and engineering. Our history is a testament to our commitment to quality and innovation.

Sustainability is not just a buzzword at ExBo Visual; it's a guiding principle. We proudly uphold a sustainability promise that permeates every aspect of our operations. From responsibly sourced materials to eco-conscious production processes, we're dedicated to reducing our environmental impact while maintaining the highest standards of visual excellence.

As part of The Jason Group's national expansion strategy, ExBo Visual has taken bold steps to create an integrated national network. This expansion includes the recent acquisition of Artcraft in five East-Coast States, bolstering our capabilities and reach. We are now better equipped than ever to serve clients across Australia with unmatched expertise and efficiency.

Leading the charge in indigenous engagement and cultural awareness is Danny Ford OAM, ExBo's esteemed Chairperson. Danny's roots trace back to the Noongar people, with connections to the Wadjuk, Yuet, Ballardong, and Wilman clans. With nearly three decades of experience in the WA public service, his qualifications include a Bachelor of Social Work and a Diploma of Teaching. His career has spanned roles in child protection, family support, housing, mental health, and Aboriginal affairs. Danny's commitment to positive change is further evident in his roles on boards such as the Clontarf Foundation, Polly Farmer Foundation, ICEA, and the Wungening Aboriginal Corporation.

In closing, ExBo Visual is more than a provider of print and signage solutions; we are your partners in transforming ideas into vibrant realities. With a history steeped in excellence, a dedication to sustainability, and a commitment to indigenous engagement, we invite you to embark on a creative journey with us. Together, we can bring your vision to life and make a positive impact on our world.

businesses.name: Fildes Food Safety
businesses.description:
The Fildes name has become well-renowned and trusted throughout the industry for our premium quality food labelling solutions. In addition, we provide a wide range of durable and reliable kitchen implements which further contribute to improved food safety practices and reduce incidents of food poisoning while also enhancing the efficiency of food and beverage operations.

Fildes Food Safety’s products and services are designed to satisfy the demands of commercial kitchens to help maintain and improve your reputation in a number of ways including:

• Facilitating more streamlined processes

• Clearly communicating vital food information

• Reducing the danger of cross-contamination

• Protecting allergy sufferers from potentially serious adverse reactions

• Protecting the general public against the risk of debilitating food poisoning

Our extensive range of products includes a wide variety of equipment to help kitchens establish and maintain an effective food safety culture, all of which are developed with these key safety concerns at the centre of everything we do.

• Food thermometers are an indispensable tool for ensuring food is within the correct safe temperature range throughout cooking, storage and transportation. They can also help prevent food from entering the food safety ‘danger zone’ which allows for bacteria to grow most rapidly. A good-quality Fridge Freezer Thermometer, for example, can be checked periodically to help reduce food safety risks by monitoring your equipment to ensure it is maintaining the appropriate temperature levels: below 5°C for fridges and -18°C for freezers.

• Food safety labels help to quickly and clearly communicate key safety information at a glance, including use-by dates, allergen information and food preferences such as 'vegetarian' and ‘vegan’.

• Colour Coded Chopping Boards utilise an easy to follow, instantly recognisable colour coding system, making it effortless for all employees to implement and follow the kitchen rules and avoid cross-contamination.

• Commercial food and storage containers prevent the spread of airborne illnesses, guard against contaminants such as dust and insects and also help eliminate the risk of cross-contamination

• Food safety posters serve as a convenient point of reference and a constant reminder to staff of the importance of food safety procedures such as e.g. Food Storage Temperature Chart

For all of your food safety needs contact one of our friendly team on 1800 673 644 or send us an email via sales@fildesfoodsafety.com.au. You can also view the full product range by visiting our online store.

About Us

From 2 to 3 Relationship and Marriage Counselling Sydney will provide you with the essential knowledge and skills you need to make healthy relationships (with yourself… and with others) that thrive.

Giving relationship and marriage counselling Sydney to individuals and couples from pregnancy into the early years

From 2 to 3 provides relationship and marriage counselling Sydney for those taking the big step in to parenthood. Located on Sydney’s North Shore, we are a certified practice that uses our training and wealth of experience to aid both individuals and couples who are creating a family.

The entire process of having and bringing up a child is among the most complex that an individual and a couple can experience. It creates a particular set of challenges to each family, and going through them can strain even the strongest couples. From 2 to 3 relationship and marriage counselling Sydney provides a service that prides itself on promoting open, honest discussion, breaking down barriers to communication, and encouraging stronger bonds as you move through this unique time.

My name is Ginny Lindsay, and I bring a wealth of formal training and personal experience to the fold. I have assisted hundreds of couples take on the difficulties of creating a life, and look forward to helping you. You can read more about me here.

From 2 to 3 offers couples and marriage counselling Sydney services across the North Shore and to the entirety of Sydney. We are ready to help you to transition in to parenthood, joyfully, happily, and together.

From 2 to 3, a relationship and marriage counselling Sydney practice established by Ginny Lindsay who is also its Principal Therapist, has been providing help to individuals and couples in life-changing situations that may affect communication between partners.

About Ginny

Who am I?

I’m an experienced psychotherapist and counsellor, and Principal Therapist at From 2 to 3, a couple counselling service dedicated to helping couples adjust to the challenges of life with a newborn. Obviously my academic background is important, and you can read it below, but I strongly believe it’s my personal journey that enables me to offer my clients the greatest value.

I am a single working mother with a gorgeous grown son. When my boy was only seventeen months old, my husband had left and I was dealing with post-natal depression and anxiety and felt ill equipped to deal with it. Since then, I have learnt, through hard times and rewarding times, to adapt to my changing situations and understand the impact that a baby has on relationships. It is my life experience, combined with my extensive studies, that has given me the knowledge and compassion to support others in similar situations.

I passionately believe that growing your family from two to three can be a lot less stressful if you have the right help. I am dedicated to working with couples having their first baby and helping them face the changes in relationship dynamics that occur during this challenging transitional time.

Even though our relationship ended, my ex-husband and I worked together and learnt from our respective pasts to develop a respectful relationship with each other, which provided a solid foundation for our son. I have also been privileged to have the experience of introducing a new partner into my family’s world, where we have accepted a new version of going from ‘two to three’.

I hope to have the opportunity to support you on your journey to loving each other, your child and finding great happiness together.

HARRIS CALORIFIC Co., a pioneer in the production of gas welding and cutting apparatus, was founded by John Harris, who discovered the oxyacetylene method of cutting and welding equipment in 1899 while conducting research on the manufacture of synthetic rubies. His discovery led to the manufacture of the nation’s first flame-cutting torch.
After exhibiting his cutting torch at the 1904 St. Louis World’s Fair, he established the company in a small shop on Cleveland’s west side in 1905. Harris continued to refine its gas torches and began to produce related accessories such as gas regulators.
After World War II, the company found new markets for its products in research laboratories and aircraft. Under Clarence Taylor, Harris expanded its national distribution system, developed new equipment, stepped up its advertising program, and established subsidiaries and distributorships abroad.
In 2006 the Harris Calorific, Inc. and J.W. Harris Company were merged together to form The Harris Products Group. This integration supported the combining of consumables and equipment for welding, cutting, brazing and soldering for our customer base.
Included in the J.W. Harris acquisition was Autobraze, a manufacturer of precision brazing rings and return bends utilized in the HVAC industry.
The Harris Products Group includes facilities in the United States, Italy, Poland, Spain and Mexico giving the company a broad global footprint. Harris Calorific organization is a world leader in gas cutting and welding equipment, while J.W. Harris produces the consumables that are complementary to the equipment line.

businesses.name: Honeybloom Florals
businesses.description:
Dunsborough, Western Australia, is home to the enchanting world of Honeybloom Florals, a floral haven brought to life by the artistic vision and heartfelt passion of Candice Honeybone. Here, amidst the beauty of this coastal paradise, a business thrives that embodies the magic of flowers and the enduring commitment of three generations to the art of floristry.

Candice's Floral Fairytale

Candice's journey into the realm of floristry unfolds like a fairytale. From her earliest memories, she found herself captivated by the allure of flowers, spending her childhood immersed in the delicate artistry under her mother's studio table. These early moments of wonder planted the seeds of a passion that would grow into the vibrant tapestry of Honeybloom Florals.

The Essence of Honeybloom Florals

As the proud torchbearer of the Honeybloom Florals legacy, Candice's passion for flowers permeates every corner of her studio. What began as a family tradition has evolved into a thriving business, where the art of floristry is infused with genuine emotion and a touch of magic. At Honeybloom Florals, every arrangement is a testament to Candice's boundless enthusiasm for the floral craft.

Candice Honeybone's distinctive style is a harmonious blend of romance and whimsy, capable of transporting you to a world of beauty and enchantment. Choosing Honeybloom Florals is an invitation to experience more than a floral arrangement – it's an immersion into a realm where each bloom weaves a narrative, capturing the essence of life's most precious moments.

Legacy of Floral Excellence: Three Generations Unveiled

The Honeybone family's dedication to the art of floristry spans three generations, a legacy built on the pillars of quality, creativity, and an unwavering love for flowers. Beatrice, Candice's grandmother and a pioneer in local floristry, laid the foundation for excellence, a legacy continued by Candice as she carries forward the family tradition with passion and innovation.

Honeybloom Florals specializes in crafting floral masterpieces for a wide range of occasions and settings. Whether it's the opulence of a wedding, the modern chic of a corporate event, or the simplicity of an elegant bouquet, Candice's creativity knows no boundaries. The studio offers an array of whimsical arrangements, ensuring that the magic of flowers becomes an integral part of everyday life.

Dunsborough's Influence: Nature's Palette

Dunsborough, with its stunning beaches and lush landscapes, serves as the quintessential backdrop for Candice's floral creations. The natural beauty of this coastal town inspires the organic and natural elements in Candice's designs. The Honeybone family's deep roots in the community further enhance the local charm infused into every creation.

At Honeybloom Florals, the client's experience takes center stage. Candice believes that every client should feel like a cherished part of the family. This sentiment is reflected in the personalized service she provides, taking the time to understand the client's vision and desires to ensure that each creation surpasses expectations.

Embrace the Floral Magic: Connect with Honeybloom Florals

Embark on a journey into the enchanting world of blooms with Honeybloom Florals. Candice Honeybone and her family's legacy invite you to experience a floral spectacle like no other. Whether planning a grand event or seeking to add a touch of whimsy to daily life, Honeybloom Florals brings expertise, creativity, and passion to turn floral dreams into vibrant reality.

Contact Honeybloom Florals today, and let Candice's floral creations add beauty and magic to the chapters of your life. With every petal telling a story and every arrangement a masterpiece, let the language of flowers paint an exquisite picture in your world.

businesses.description:
Integra Systems, established in 1991, is a 100% Australian-owned industrial product design and advanced manufacturing enterprise in Melbourne’s North, centered around light metal. With a motto to ‘Make Your Vision Real’, Integra transforms customer concepts into fully resolved designs that can then be produced in Integra’s advanced manufacturing facility.
Integra are recognised as leaders in Industry 4.0, having fully digitised their own operations. All Integra innovations are driven by the principles of The Circular Economy, particularly waste minimisation and a cradle-to-cradle approach across each stage of the design, manufacturing and repurposing lifecycle.
Working extensively with universities to nurture the ‘manufacturers of tomorrow’ and employing people from different cultures and backgrounds, Integra Systems constantly pushes boundaries while remaining committed to their core values: respect, progressiveness, collaboration, passion and sustainability.
What we do:
The three pillars of Integra Systems are:
1. Product Design and Development
Product design and development underpins everything at Integra. Following the principles of a circular economy and design for manufacture, Integra’s design and development teams turn concept ideas for products and components into fully resolved designs, poised for manufacture. Similarly, existing products and components are redesigned for manufacturing efficiency.
2. Industry 4.0 Digitised Advanced Manufacturing
Integra’s advanced manufacturing facilities are where fully designed and specified products move into the manufacturing phase with world-class innovative machinery. The co-location of Integra’s design and manufacturing is unique in the Australian manufacturing industry. Live prototyping, testing and refinement on-site ensures the smoothest, most cost-effective manufacturing techniques.
3. Integra TransForm
Integra TransForm is Integra Systems’ proprietary products division, where these incubation ideas have been launched into market ready products that deliver Innovation for Performance to TransForm and optimise your business. The range comprises of electric sit-stand workstations, digital kiosk displays and waste separation bins.
Integra Systems is an ISO 9001:2015 quality certified manufacturer and the partner of choice for a diverse range of industries.

Who We Are

KAD3D is a Melbourne-based 3D printing and design company specialising in rapid prototyping, end-use parts, and short-run manufacturing. Established with a focus on precision, reliability, and speed, we’ve grown to become Australia’s highest-rated 3D printing service, with over 300 five-star Google reviews and a reputation for delivering outstanding results.

- FDM 3D Printing – strong, affordable parts for prototypes and end-use applications.

Andrew Mead: A Craftsman's Journey

Andrew Mead's journey began in 1979 when he embarked on a four-year apprenticeship as a carriage builder for the State Rail Authority. Innovation, perseverance and close attention to customer needs have characterized Kennametal since its founding. In 1938, after years of research, metallurgist Philip M. McKenna created a tungsten-titanium carbide alloy for cutting tools that provided a productivity breakthrough in the machining of steel. “Kennametal®” tools cut faster and lasted longer, and thereby facilitated metalworking in products from automobiles to airliners to machinery.
When the wartime boom ended, Kennametal sought new ways to exploit the toughness and wear resistance of tungsten carbide alloys. In the mid-1940s, the company pioneered the use of carbide tooling for mining, which led to the development of the continuous mining machine. Kennametal also found uses for tungsten carbide in demanding specialty applications where resistance to wear was vital, such as in valves, dies, drill bits and snowplow blades.

businesses.description:
Leussink is a state-of-the-art engineering business with over 40 years’ experience and an ever-growing range of capabilities. Whether you are looking for machining of bespoke components, or require a project manufactured to turn-key level, Leussink will leverage its world-class thinking, skills and reputation for each application, regardless of the required scope of work.
As a second-generation family-owned business, Leussink has been providing complete design, fabrication, and machining services and solutions for all industry sectors spanning over four decades. Our company is firmly focused on modernising and revolutionising workshops and production facilities around Australia through the creation of tailored welding and fixturing systems.
We don’t believe in providing our clients with set-and-forget solutions. You can’t modernise or revolutionise an industry that way. Which is why we have a world-leading after-sales service, where we meet clients at regular intervals to ensure our solutions are performing to, or exceeding, expectations. This includes providing ongoing services and technical assistance as needed, and performance reviews that highlight potential upgrades and improvements, to make sure your business can meet and scale with demand.
We provide a wide range of engineering solutions, from world-leading welding & fixturing tables and accessories through to portable metrology arms that deliver the highest accuracy for part qualification. Working closely with our clients, we tailor the right solution to suit your requirements, making sure you have parts you need, not parts you’ve just been given. We also plan and anticipate spare part requirements, making sure they are available when required, and minimising down-time for repairs.
Being locally based in NSW with parts and accessories stored at our warehouse means we are able to deliver a working solution, to your exact specifications, when you need it. This also makes communicating and consulting far easier, and more efficient as we’re open when you are.
We also understand the importance of security when it comes dealing with sensitive customer information, which is why we actively work to ensure we have strict security measures in place, especially regarding the cyber aspect of our business.
Leussink customers can be assured that we will take all necessary precautions to guarantee that their Intellectual Property remains secure. This is also applicable within our own supply chain. Our third-party IT supplier supports us in achieving this commitment.
Demonstrating our staunch commitment to protecting the IP of our customers, in early 2018 we participated in AusIndustry’s Cyber Security Maturity Assessment. This evaluation follows the US National Institute of Standards and Technology framework and assesses risk identification, threat detection, protection, response and recovery. As a result of our participation, we have been assessed as ‘low risk’.

businesses.name: Plazmax Pty Ltd
businesses.description:
Originally established under the name of “CNC Engineering Solutions”, Plazmax Technologies has been in the CNC game since 2011.
We initially offered a service designing machinery and parts and manufacturing, using CNC milling machinery. The business plan was always to eventually identify a need within the market and manufacture our own branded product. Our criteria required that the product needed to include technical elements that would utilise and challenge our existing skill sets.
Through a set of circumstances, we found our way to Plasma cutting and more particularly the design and manufacture of CNC profile cutting systems. After a period of research, we identified Hypertherm as a world leader in the design and manufacture of plasma cutting componentry.
We purchased the (then newly released) PMX105 power source and built our first CNC plasma cutting system, (which is still producing products today).
From that point, our learning process was rapid, as was the evolution of our designs.
We obtained OEM status from Hypertherm and sent our technicians to the USA for further training on Hypertherm products and processes.
We rebranded ourselves as Plazmax Technologies to better reflect our changing business and embarked on an accelerated period of prototyping.
Our designs exclusively use Hypertherm hardware and software products providing technologically advanced, fully integrated, automated solutions for our customers.
As our business has grown we have been fortunate enough to attract some very gifted and talented team members who have allowed us to lift our level of expertise to a very high standard and we now lead the way, embracing and implementing Hypertherm’s latest technologies.

businesses.name: Polito Wood Fire Ovens
businesses.description:
There’s something special about cooking and eating outdoors in your own wood fire oven. Food simply tastes better when enjoyed in the fresh Australian air.

Nothing beats a wood fired oven in your backyard and Polito’s wood fired ovens, made right here in Melbourne, are the best you can buy.

HOME OVENS:

Wood fire oven used in a pizzeria, restaurant, hotels etc need to be of the highest quality material and building methods. The importance of the cooking floor tile is vital, a 50mm thick floor oven tiles which has a minimum Alumina content of 38% and to reach temperature of 1350 dg C. Polito believes 100% on the thermal mass, reaching the wall/floor thickness layers of approximately 300mm. By achieving thermal mass the wood fire oven retains/captures the heat which results to burning less firewood used leaving 80% of the internal oven footprint to cook. Polito commercial wood fire ovens are pre built and ready to be delivered for installation. Ovens come with a commercial metal black powered coated stand.

COMMERCIAL OVENS:

Polito Wood Fire Ovens in Melbourne manufactures commercial wood fire ovens with a wide range of sizes and styles. The hand crafted ready built commercial pizza ovens are constructed with sophisticated technology where our castable refractory is high alumina, by using high quality materials formula which includes calcium aluminate cement, Australian clay processed to calcined refractory aggregates, kilned, crushed, weighed and sized. This formula achieves 40% to 50% alumina which enables to heat the oven quicker and retain temperatures for longer period. Polito Ovens assembling methods include High temperatures insulating materials as they are of high importance to retain heat. Ceramic fibre blanket and vermiculite to name a few. The pre assembled commercial wood fire pizza oven range is designed for restaurants and pizzerias looking for a high- end pizza oven to manage for baking Pizza Napoletana and more woodfired dishes.

DIY OVENS:

Polito do it yourself complete kit is supplied with all components to build this high quality wood fire oven. It saves you loads of money when you choose to build it yourself, all instruction and phone support is available. This kit is packed on a pallet and shipped anywhere in the Australia/NZ

JAMIE OLIVER OVENS:

Jamie Oliver's Wood-fired ovens are about more than just pizza. Not only can you use them to bake beautiful breads, turn out golden vegetables and melt-in the- mouth stews, but cooking next to an open fire brings out unique flavours in every dish. Cooking in a Jamie Oliver wood fired pizza oven forces you to slow down, to reconnect with food and work with nature. These ovens bring friends and family together and get you outside in all seasons. businesses.description:
About Us

At Preston Builders, we specialise in building future-proof homes that will fit in with every stage of your life – and with our stress-free process, you’re guaranteed an experience that’s memorable for all the correct reasons.

Every future-proof home we develop follows a Livable Homes Blueprint. They all are single-storey with wide hallways and doorways, perfect for almost any living arrangements or requirements – so no matter how big or small your project, you’ll know that your investment will go the distance.

Why build or renovate with us?

At Preston Builders, we build your forever home. Your new home or renovation can let you enjoy your home longer with some careful consideration. By working together, incorporating our experience and your vision, we build a plan which suits your changing lifestyle. Livable housing design is our passion. Designing a home that adapts as you age or as your family grows can save you lots of money on future renovation costs.

We Design For Longevity

Every home that we construct follows the principles of Adaptable Living and contains the key features of an accessible design, prioritising comfort, safety, and ease of access. This way, you’ll understand that your home will always be able to accommodate your needs, and if you do ever decide to sell, it will be a much more attractive prospect for your future buyers.

We Are An Experienced Team

We’re proud to say that our team has a combined 100+ years of industry experience and counting. Since opening our doors in 2007, we’ve built many forever homes and loved serving our clients.

We Pride Ourselves On Quality

Workmanship And Reliable Communication

Building a home is a big deal, so you can rest assured that when you navigate the process with us, you’ll never feel like you’re going it alone. We’ll deliver workmanship that catches the eye and make sure no critical details ever slip through the cracks.

All Our Work is Guaranteed

Our finished products are built to last and backed by a guarantee. Plus, with the combined experience and vision in our team, we have the experience to develop a plan that suits your lifestyle and your budget, so you can trust that your forever home will reflect your needs and preferences. You can forget budget blowouts!

Meet the Team

Wayne is a respected Livable Homes Guideline Accessor for the Liveable Housing Design organisation. Lee has a nursing background and all the skills to draw up a plan for your home that suits you and your family perfectly.

Wayne and Lee are keen about ensuring your home is suitable to your lifestyle. In particular, they focus on building “Forever Homes”. If you want to be sure that your home meets your aging needs, Wayne is a Livable Homes Guideline Assessor for the Liveable Housing Design organisation, and Lee has a nursing background and enjoys taking the time to draw your home plans to ensure your home suits your family care needs. Together, they are the team you’ll want on your side throughout the procedure of building your accessible forever home.

businesses.name: Prosser Built
businesses.description:
In the world of construction, few names evoke a sense of legacy and excellence as the Prosser family does. For over eight decades, the Prosser family has been at the forefront of building and development, shaping the landscape of Bunbury and beyond. From its modest beginnings to its current stature as a multi-disciplined commercial and residential project provider, Prosser Built stands as a testament to the power of vision, dedication, and generational continuity.

The Prosser story began with Ron Prosser, a first-generation builder with a dream and a small joinery shed on Beach Road in Bunbury. Ron's passion for craftsmanship and determination to deliver exceptional quality propelled him forward. As demand grew, he expanded his operations, eventually establishing a large sawmill on Strickland Street. This marked a pivotal moment in the family's journey, as Ron shifted from joinery to home building, setting the stage for the birth of Auden + Prosser Builders and Prosser Homes.

With the baton of leadership passed to the second generation, Steve Prosser continued to build upon his father's legacy. Under Steve's stewardship, Prosser Homes and R+M Prosser + Son became synonymous with innovation and excellence in "off the plan" home building in Bunbury. Steve's ability to envision and adapt led the company into uncharted territory—commercial building—showcasing the family's versatility and forward-thinking approach.

Today, as the third-generation builder, Dave Prosser carries forward the family's torch with pride and purpose. Dave's deep respect for tradition is matched only by his commitment to embracing the future. At the helm of Prosser Built, Dave has steered the company to new heights, guided by a relentless pursuit of quality and a dedication to preserving the essence of Prosser craftsmanship.

Prosser Built isn't just a construction company; it's a reflection of the Prosser ethos. Our comprehensive suite of services encompasses everything from design conceptualization to the final nail, all orchestrated seamlessly by a unified team operating under one roof. This integrated approach eliminates fragmentation and fosters clear communication, ensuring that every project progresses with efficiency and transparency.

What sets Prosser Built apart is our discerning approach to project selection. We aren't driven by quantity but by the opportunity to showcase our expertise. Our focus on commercial projects and architectural builds speaks to our commitment to delivering structures that are not just functional but also exceptional in design and execution.

Central to our success is the Prosser commitment to professionalism and clear communication. We recognize that every project is unique, and our approach is tailored to suit each client's distinct needs. This personalized touch forms the foundation of the relationships we cultivate—a testament to our belief that collaboration is the cornerstone of great construction.

In closing, Prosser Built stands as a living testament to the Prosser family's journey through generations. Ron's dedication, Steve's innovation, and Dave's leadership have woven a tapestry of excellence that extends far beyond bricks and mortar. With each project we undertake, we honor the past, embrace the present, and chart a course for a future where the Prosser legacy continues to shine as a beacon of inspiration in the construction industry.

Based in Sydney we supply laser solutions and optronics equipment.
EXPERTISE:
Raymax Applications was established in 1992, and the company has continued to grow its expertise and supply base sourcing from highly reputable laser and optronics equipment manufacturers in Europe, the UK and America. Our team of physicists and factory trained engineers, along with our extensive knowledge of laser technology and applications in both Australia and New Zealand, means we offer reputable advice, service and support.

To bring the best, most effective leading-edge laser and optronics solutions to advance manufacturing industries, and research and development organisations.
VISION:
To dedicate our expertise to achieving our goals of innovation, best practice and first-class customer service, to the benefit of both our customers and suppliers.

We supply lasers used in the common processes of welding of metals and plastics due to their efficiency; in selective laser melting and sintering as well as cutting, brazing and hardening. Lasers are particularly useful when dealing with microstructures, machining small components less than 200 microns for joining, wire stripping or skiving and drilling.
Experience across a range of industries ensures Raymax Applications provides the best solutions to assist smart manufacturing in Australia.

businesses.name: SJK Collective
businesses.description:
When it comes to electrical, air conditioning, and plumbing services in Brisbane, you can count on the expert team at SJK Collective. We've been serving our community for over a decade, offering affordable and professional solutions with the motto, "no problems, only solutions."

As a locally-owned company based in Brisbane, SJK Collective has become a trusted name in the industry. We provide a full spectrum of services, including electrical, air conditioning, plumbing, gas, and solar services to clients in Brisbane and its surrounding regions.

At SJK Collective, we cater to both residential and commercial clients, offering maintenance services to a wide range of high-profile customers in Brisbane. Our team of highly skilled, fully qualified professional tradesmen brings years of expertise to every project, ensuring that each job is completed safely and to the highest standards. We take pride in our punctuality, dedication to excellent customer service, and our commitment to leaving every job site clean and tidy.

We believe in transparent pricing, eliminating any concerns about hidden charges. Customer service is at the heart of our mission, and we're delighted to offer advice tailored to meet your unique needs.

Our Origin Tale

SJK Collective's journey begins with our founder and Managing Director, Scott Kilkeary. Scott has always been dedicated to local businesses that aim to improve the living conditions of Brisbane's residents. His journey commenced with the management of a small business in Ashgrove, Brisbane. Later, he transitioned to the construction industry, where he rose to the position of foreman, overseeing projects in Brisbane's CBD and its suburbs. During this time, he gained invaluable experience working with contractors from various trades—some highly professional and reliable, while others were less dependable. Recognizing the inconsistencies among contractors, Scott saw the challenges that residents and businesses in South East Queensland faced when seeking electrical and other trade services. It was often a gamble to determine whether a contractor would be punctual, reliable, and professional. This realization sparked Scott's mission to provide a comprehensive and trustworthy range of electrical services to benefit the Brisbane community.

Our Founding

On June 1, 2013, "SJK Electrical" was born in Toowong, with Scott as its sole employee. Starting from humble beginnings, Scott worked diligently to build a reputation as a friendly, trustworthy, and consistently reliable electrical contractor. As our reputation grew, so did our team, leading to a move to larger headquarters in Indooroopilly. As our client base continued to expand, we relocated to Jindalee and ultimately established our permanent home in Sumner, complete with a spacious warehouse and office space. Today, our office is staffed with a strong support team, and our team of experienced technicians and hard-working apprentices continues to grow. Throughout our expansion, SJK Collective's mantra has remained constant: to grow and better serve the Brisbane community while staying true to our roots and core values.

Ready to Serve

Contact us today for all your electrical, plumbing, and air conditioning needs. We're eager to work with you and provide professional, cost-effective solutions.

businesses.name: Suitsme
businesses.description:
About Us

When it comes to helping with your mental health, we do things a little differently at Suitsme.

We’re passionate about providing you with the ability to take control, with excellent service and the ability to choose your own support team.

If you’re searching for a registered NDIS service with a difference, you’ve come to the right place.

How can we help?

Getting started

Your personal goals mean everything to us. We will work with you to design the best program to achieve them, help you find great people to help, and make it fast and simple for you to control the process using the Suitsme app.

At Suitsme, we concentrate on helping people with their mental health so we learn how to provide really good support when you need it. That is why we offer a flexible and prompt service:

Book at short notice

No wait lists

No cancellation fee

If you cancel a session with at least eight hours’ notice, then you won’t be charged

No notice period to end a service agreement

To join Suitsme you must have an NDIS plan, live in Perth and be over the age of 16.

How we work

You’re always in the driver’s seat. That is what makes Suitsme different from a lot of other services. First, you decide on the workers that suits you best. Then, we use a co-design approach to figure out how we can best work together. It’s about you sharing with us what you want, because you know what’s best for you. This article explains a bit more about it.

Getting started

The Suitsme app makes it quick and easy for you to take control of your own arrangements – choose who you would like to work with, when and where you want your sessions, and how you’d like to work together. Change your arrangements at any time. Setting up the app is very simple but let us know if you need help.

Choosing a support team

Our support workers all have knowledge of mental health; they are checked, screened and hired by Suitsme. Many workers include their credentials in the “About me” section of their app profile, along with all their personal details so you can check out and select the workers you think will be a good match. We have come up with some guidelines to ensure you have the best experience with your support worker. And if you decide you want a change, you can do that on the app at any time.

How we charge

Suitsme charges in accordance with the NDIS Pricing Arrangements and Price Limits. Our rates can vary based on time of day and what support you are accessing. Our weekday rate for core support is $64.04 per hour. Check our current pricing.

Operating hours

Suitsme operates from 7am to 7pm, 7 days a week. If you have core support funding, you can book a worker any time during our operating hours. If you have potential building funding, you can book a worker on weekdays.

The SURE SHADE ® Basic 80C L1 W slat profile is 80mm wide and is of a more robust construction than the 100F, due to a rolled edge, and can be manufactured to be more wind stable as compared to the 100F. businesses.name: Titomic Limited
businesses.address: Ground Floor, 365 Ferntree Gully Road Mount Waverley Victoria 3149
businesses.description:
In 2007, Titomic Founder Jeff Lang was invited by the CSIRO to participate in an initiative named ‘Ore for More’ – a project which sought to utilise and add value to Australia’s abundant titanium mineral sands, from which ilmenite and rutile are extracted. With over 300,000,000 tonnes of titanium mineral sands within its crust, Australia is home to the world’s largest deposits of mineral sands.
Initially, it was noted that these minerals could be transformed into metal powders for use in the emerging market of additive manufacturing, however the volume consumed by many 3D printers and the industry overall is small, resulting in a relatively small market. Re-examining the problem, this led the team to explore how a larger volume of titanium could be used in manufacturing at scale and speed through new or existing technologies.
Throughout the process, the research team looked toward Cold Spray for a solution – a technique of supersonically depositing metal particles onto a scaffold to create metal coatings. Drawing upon Professor Fox’s medical research surrounding scaffold-based tissue engineering, the team explored the use of this process to create metal parts by building particles layer upon layer. It was found that not only was the process well-suited for additive manufacturing, it also provided a range of unique advantages.
Building on this success, the founders went on to patent and licence the technology via the CSIRO. After extensive research and development, a company named Titomic was established in 2014 to commercialise this technology, trademarking this novel manufacturing method as Titomic Kinetic Fusion ® . With this technology, Titomic now offers industrial-scale additive manufacturing utilising titanium and other high-performance metals.

businesses.name: Weld East Fabricators
businesses.description:
GENERAL & HEAVY FABRICATION

We offer a wide range of fabrication services to our customers, including HD robotic CNC plasma cutting, CNC bending and rolling, welding, assembly, design, certification, finishing, sandblasting, repair, refurbishment, and steel supply. Our expert fabricators are capable of working with a variety of steel grades of varying hardness levels.

Low Carbon (Mild Steel) Plate Grade 250, 350

High Carbon steel plate

Steel sheet 1mm and up

Boiler Plate, Duraflex K1042, Bisalloy 80, 400, 500

Stainless steel grades 316 and 304

Aluminium

WELDING

Welding is the process of fusing materials such as metals in order to seamlessly join them. Our professional and qualified fabricators at Weld East are fully-trained and compliant with the following welding processes:

MIG (Metal Inert Gas) - GMAW (Gas Metal Arc Welding)

Arc Welding - SMAW (Shielded Metal Arc Welding)

TIG (Tungsten Inert Gas) - GTAW (Gas Tungsten Arc Welding)

FCAW (Flux Cored Arc Welding)

Our quality assurance system incorporates a series of quality gates to ensure high quality performance is maintained at every stage of fabrication.

You can rely on us to provide any supporting documentation required including weld procedure specification (WPS), concept drawings, and engineering certification.

LASER / PLASMA CUTTING

Plasma Cutting is a process used to cut steel using a plasma torch, which uses a powerful electric arc to create plasma out of a blast of ordinary dried air to vaporise, or literally ‘plasmatise’ the metal that is being cut. Our robotic CNC Plasma Cutter is designed to provide excellent cutting and bevelling performance on material up to 25mm thick. Our machine is fully robotic and able to cut from a CAM file generated from AutoCAD files. Our machine is fully capable of processing both small and large orders in short time frames.

PRESSING & FOLDING

Weld East Fabricators is proud to deliver a full range of manufacturing services on-site. Our Perth fabrication workshop is equipped with press brakes in a range of sizes for plate pressing and folding. The press brake CNC controls allow us to save your parts to our database making repeat orders simple and cost effective for batch produced parts. Our largest press is built to handle up to 25mm thickness and in sizes up to 3m x 5m.

PAINTING & FINISHING

Our Perth fabrication workshop is fully equipped with industrial spray painting facilities. We have the equipment and experience to give your project whatever finish you require including 2-Pack, priming, and top coats.
